description:
Nova vaga disponível para Gerente de Compliance em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Graduação completa em Direito, Administração de Empresas, Economia e/ou afins. Experiência em análise, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, indicadores e criação de planos de ação Inglês e espanhol como diferencial Experiência em Gestão de Programas de Compliance Pacote Office avançado. Desejável Pós graduação na área de Compliance ou Governança Corporativa.  Desenvolver e implementar um programa de integridade eficaz, identificando, avaliando e mitigando riscos de conformidade dentro da organização.  Aconselhar e orientar as lideranças em questões de conformidade. Realizar avaliação de risco de integridade periódica nas operações. Revisar e implementar políticas e procedimentos internos para garantir a conformidade com normas regulatórias e garantir a aplicação de boas práticas de integridade. Desenvolver e supervisionar controle interno para prevenir ou lidar com violações de diretrizes legais e políticas internas de integridade. Avaliar e supervisionar a eficiência e eficácia dos controles internos de integridade e melhorá-los continuamente. Supervisionar atividades de monitoramento contínuo para detectar e prevenir violações de conformidade. Elaborar o plano anual de treinamento e supervisionar a preparação e condução de treinamento para colaboradores e terceiros sobre práticas de conformidade e ética corporativa. Elaborar o plano anual de comunicação e supervisionar a condução deste. Supervisionar as investigações internas e auxiliar na implementação de ações corretivas. Coordenar e realizar testes de conformidade para assegurar que as práticas da empresa estejam de acordo com todas diretrizes legais e políticas internas de integridade. Avaliar a efetividade do programa de integridade e buscar a melhoria contínua. Preparar relatórios e indicadores para a alta administração e órgãos reguladores externos e apoiar na auditorias. Definir planos para gerenciar uma crise ou violação de conformidade. Servir como ponto de contato para autoridades regulatórias e gerenciar qualquer comunicação relevante. Implementar ISO 37.301.

title: Analista de compras pleno (foco em facilities)
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de compras pleno (foco em facilities) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:  Superior completo em áreas relacionadas a administração, engenharia, afins; Desejável MBA/Especialização em Compras ou correlatas; Experiência mínima de 3 anos em contratações de Facilities; Conhecimento em ferramentas de sourcing (TCO, Cost breakdown, Porter, Kraljic, Drivers de Custo e etc); Experiência na Gestão da Categoria de Facilities (diferencial); Experiência em condução de Strategic Sourcing da Categoria de Facilities (diferencial); Experiência em negociação de contratos de alto valores; Experiência em abertura de custos; Conhecimento avançado em negociação; Conhecimento do processo e de tributação nas aquisições de materiais e serviços; Construção de apresentações para report executivo; Disponibilidade para atuação em Campinas-SP.  Você se destaca se tiver: Desejável conhecimento em ERP - SAP e Oracle; Desejável conhecimento em Portal de Compras - Ariba, Coupa ou outros; Conhecimento ServiceNow / Salesforce.  Você focará em: Trabalhar nas contratações da categoria de Facilities, analisando o mercado e encontrando oportunidades internas; Promover a integração com todos os departamentos da empresa, gerindo stakeholders (áreas requisitantes, fornecedores e demais áreas envolvidas no processo); Atuar dedicadamente em promover redução de custos nos contratos atuais, desenvolvendo novas alternativas; Criar acordos de fornecimento, através de contratos, com o objetivo de gerar economia nas negociações; Garantir o cumprimento das metas de resultados estabelecidas para os processos da categoria, considerando os aspectos financeiros, qualitativos e quantitativos, mediante acompanhamento e controle dos indicadores de performance e tomando ações preventivas e corretivas necessárias à melhoria contínua; Desenvolver relacionamento estratégico com os fornecedores; Acompanhar a evolução dos preços praticados pelos fornecedores para os serviços de Facilities; Apoiar a liderança em iniciativas de melhoria de processos para transformar a eficiência e a eficácia das compras; Garantir o cumprimento das políticas e diretrizes das empresas; Manter a proximidade com as áreas de negócio e ter foco no cliente; Ser uma referência técnica e suporte para os demais compradores; Ser referência para equipe quanto ao comportamento, atuando dentro dos valores da empresa; Elaboração de apresentações de executivas das conduções dos projetos de Facilities.

title: Ux designer pleno
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Ux designer pleno em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Estamos em busca de um(a) UX/Product Designer Pleno II para atuar em uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia do Brasil, contribuindo diretamente para a construção e evolução de produtos digitais que geram impacto em escala. Buscamos uma pessoa com forte visão de produto, autonomia, pensamento analítico e capacidade de transformar desafios complexos em experiências intuitivas, eficientes e orientadas a resultados.           Responsabilidade e atribuições:  Conduzir o processo de Design end-to-end, desde a descoberta do problema até a validação da solução.  Realizar pesquisas com usuários, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e análises de comportamento.  Criar fluxos, wireframes, protótipos de baixa e alta fidelidade.  Facilitar workshops de discovery, ideação e cocriação.  Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplas squads e iniciativas de negócio.  Utilizar dados, métricas e insights para embasar decisões de produto e experiência.  Trabalhar em parceria com Product Managers, Tech Leads, Desenvolvedores e demais stakeholders.  Garantir consistência, qualidade e evolução contínua das experiências digitais.  Apoiar a implementação das soluções junto aos times de desenvolvimento.           Requisitos e qualificações:   Experiência em UX Design, Product Design ou áreas correlatas.  Vivência com Design Thinking, Arquitetura da Informação e Design de Interação.  Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade.  Domínio de ferramentas de prototipação e design de interfaces.  Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na definição de métodos, entregáveis e priorização de atividades.  Conhecimento em ambientes ágeis e trabalho com times multidisciplinares.  Excelente comunicação, organização e storytelling.  Inglês fluente. Diferenciais Espanhol fluente como terceira lingua  Experiência em produtos digitais complexos e ambientes enterprise.  Conhecimento em Design Systems.  Vivência em indústria, operações, automação ou tecnologia.  Experiência atuando em múltiplas squads simultaneamente.  Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao processo de Design. O que esperamos de você Perfil protagonista e orientado a resultados.  Mentalidade baseada em dados e evidências.  Facilidade para navegar em contextos complexos e multidisciplinares.  Curiosidade, senso crítico e aprendizado contínuo.  Capacidade de influenciar decisões através de uma visão estratégica de produto e experiência.           Informações adicionais:  Modelo de contratação: Cooperativa   Benefícios que oferecemos:  Plano de saúdePlano odontológicoWellhubDescanso remuneradoDay off no mês do aniversárioVale RefeiçãoModelo de contratação cooperativo  mais autonomia e parceria no dia a dia

title: Analista de suporte - sênior
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Analista de suporte - sênior em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Descrição da VagaSomos movidos por gente que acredita no que faz, que quer crescer junto e deixar sua marca em tudo o que entrega.Nosso dia a dia é dinâmico, colaborativo e cheio de aprendizados  e estamos sempre de portas abertas para quem quer somar. Se você busca um lugar onde suas ideias têm espaço e sua trajetória importa, vem com a gente. Estamos te esperando para criar o futuro juntos. VEM SER UM WELOVER!  O profissional atuará diretamente na administração e resolução de incidentes em ambientes virtualizados, servidores Windows e Linux, redes e segurança, garantindo a disponibilidade, desempenho e estabilidade dos serviços contratados. Procuramos um perfil técnico, analítico e orientado à excelência no atendimento, capaz de atuar em ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade. Requisitos e Qualificações          Sistemas Operacionais Experiência sólida em administração e suporte de: Windows Server; Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, Rocky Linux, Red Hat ou similares).Virtualização Experiência com plataformas de virtualização, tais como: VMware vSphere; Microsoft Hyper-V; Proxmox (desejável).Redes Conhecimentos avançados em: TCP/IP; VLANs; Switching e roteamento; DNS; DHCP; VPN; Balanceamento de carga; Troubleshooting de conectividade.Segurança Experiência na administração e suporte de firewalls corporativos. Conhecimentos em: NAT; VPN Site-to-Site e Client-to-Site; Políticas de acesso; IPS/IDS; Análise de logs e eventos de segurança.Ferramentas e Serviços Active Directory. GPO. Monitoramento de infraestrutura. Backup e recuperação de ambientes. Ferramentas de ITSM e gestão de chamados.  Diferenciais Experiência com firewalls da linha FortiGate da Fortinet. Certificações Fortinet (FCA, FCP, FCSS ou equivalentes). Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem como Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services ou Google Cloud. Conhecimentos em storage, SAN e tecnologias de backup corporativo. Experiência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e Data Centers. Conhecimentos em automação utilizando PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Certificações Microsoft, Linux, VMware ou Fortinet.  Responsabilidades e AtribuiçõesAtuar no suporte e sustentação de ambientes de infraestrutura de clientes. Realizar troubleshooting avançado em servidores Windows e Linux. Administrar e monitorar ambientes virtualizados. Atender incidentes, requisições e problemas relacionados à infraestrutura dos clientes, respeitando os SLAs estabelecidos. Executar atividades de análise de causa raiz (RCA) para incidentes recorrentes. Monitorar a saúde dos ambientes e atuar proativamente na prevenção de falhas. Apoiar processos de implantação, migração e atualização de ambientes de clientes. Administrar serviços de rede e conectividade entre ambientes on-premises, Data Center e nuvem. Realizar análise e suporte em firewalls, switches e APs. Documentar procedimentos, diagnósticos e soluções em base de conhecimento. Interagir com equipes internas, fabricantes e fornecedores para escalonamento e resolução de problemas complexos. Participar de escalas de plantão e atividades de suporte em regime 24x7, quando necessário.  Perfil Desejado Forte capacidade de diagnóstico e resolução de problemas. Excelente comunicação e relacionamento com clientes. Senso de prioridade e organização. Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão em ambientes críticos. Proatividade e foco na melhoria contínua dos serviços. Perfil colaborativo e orientado a resultados.  Formação Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.  Modelo de Trabalho Regime: CLT. Disponibilidade para participação em escalas de plantão e atendimento a incidentes críticos.  Objetivo da Função Garantir a estabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos ambientes de infraestrutura dos clientes hospedados no Data Center, atuando como referência técnica na resolução de incidentes, sustentação dos serviços e suporte especializado em plataformas virtualizadas, sistemas operacionais, redes e segurança. Representada por  Dhiego Rosa – Instagram: @dhiegorosa e YouTube: dhiegorosa   – contamos com mais de 700 mil seguidores nas redes sociais. Somos referência no universo das vendas online, fruto de uma experiência de mais de 13 anos no segmento, criando, vendendo empresas e consolidando marcas no mercado.    Nosso treinamento é reconhecido pela Amazon e pelo Mercado Livre, destacando-nos como uma das maiores empresas de mentorias e treinamentos para e-commerce da América Latina.   O que buscamos:    Buscamos um(a)  Gerente de Operações da Mentoria   para liderar e estruturar a operação da nossa principal linha de negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, padronização de processos, qualidade na entrega e desenvolvimento da equipe.   Procuramos um profissional com perfil estratégico e analítico, alta capacidade de gestão, autonomia para tomada de decisão e experiência em operações escaláveis, capaz de atuar diretamente na evolução da experiência dos mentorados e crescimento sustentável da área.    Responsabilidades:    Liderar equipe de mentores, supervisores e suporte, acompanhando performance, desenvolvimento e estruturação do time;   Garantir qualidade e consistência da operação de mentoria, assegurando padronização de processos, entregas e experiência do cliente;   Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos operacionais, metodologias e processos internos;   Acompanhar e analisar indicadores operacionais, como NPS, churn, engajamento, capacidade operacional e satisfação dos mentorados;   Realizar gestão de crises, tratativas de casos críticos, conflitos e demandas sensíveis de clientes;   Planejar capacidade operacional da equipe, onboarding e desenvolvimento de novos mentores;   Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Comercial, RH, Financeiro, Marketing e Produto.    Requisitos:    Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas;   Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de operações, customer success, consultoria, educação executiva ou áreas correlatas;   Experiência comprovada em estruturação de processos, padronização de entrega e gestão por indicadores em empresas de serviço continuado, como educação executiva, consultoria, mentoria, treinamento corporativo, SaaS B2B ou customer success de alto contato;   Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes operacionais de médio/grande porte;   Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento de performance, incluindo OKRs, KPIs, dashboards gerenciais, CRM e plataformas de operação digital;   Capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e implementação de melhorias contínuas;   Capacidade demonstrável de atuar com autonomia, senso de dono e reporte de resultados, sem dependência de direcionamento constante;   Perfil analítico, organizado, resiliente e com forte capacidade de liderança;   Vivência em operações escaláveis e ambientes de crescimento acelerado.     Diferenciais:    Experiência com infoprodutos, mentorias, educação online ou consultorias;   Conhecimento em e-commerce, marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee) e comércio digital;   Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento, scale-ups ou operações com ticket elevado;   Vivência empreendedora ou passagem por empresas em fase de crescimento acelerado, com familiaridade em ambientes dinâmicos, alta autonomia e processos em estruturação;   Compreensão da realidade do pequeno e médio empreendedor brasileiro, incluindo desafios relacionados à tributação, capital de giro, sazonalidade e gestão operacional.     Se você se identifica com a nossa missão de impactar o mercado de e-commerce e busca crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, queremos conhecer você!   Venha construir o futuro do comércio digital conosco no Grupo Escalada

description:

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.     Collaboration    Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.     Operational and Professional Conduct    Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide  .     Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:    Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up      POSITION REQUIREMENTS    Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:    Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:    Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):    Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:    C1 or above   Portuguese level required:    none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese     Child Safeguarding    Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.     EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion    EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.    Atividades:   Buscamos um profissional com perfil estratégico e comercial para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento de uma carteira regional de laboratórios clínicos, com foco no mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD). Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio.    Responsabilidades e atribuições:   • Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios;  • Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada;  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa;  • Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão;  • Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais;  • Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado;  • Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios;  • Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades;  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados;  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente;  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas;  • Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada.    Requisitos:   • Graduação completa;  • Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos;  • Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios;  • Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial;  • Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas;  • Domínio do Pacote Office;  • CNH categoria B;  • Disponibilidade para viagens;  • Residir em Campinas ou arredores;    Diferenciais   • Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos;  • Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais;  • Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado;  • Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

title: Manufacturing Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Manufacturing Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Manager to lead our FMCG production operations in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. This role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and service. The ideal candidate will bring more than 10 years of manufacturing leadership experience, including strong exposure to multinational company environments.   Key Responsibilities   Lead day-to-day manufacturing operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and cost targets.   Develop and implement production plans to meet customer demand and business objectives.   Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and waste reduction initiatives.   Ensure full compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality standards.   Monitor plant performance through KPIs and take corrective action to improve efficiency, output, and reliability.   Manage and develop operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to build a high-performance culture.   Oversee budget control, labour productivity, inventory optimisation, and cost management across the manufacturing function.   Support capital projects, process improvements, and equipment upgrades to enhance manufacturing capability.   Promote strong people leadership, coaching, succession planning, and employee engagement across the site.     Candidate Profile   Minimum 10 years of manufacturing experience, with significant leadership responsibility in the FMCG industry.   Proven experience working within a multinational company environment.   Strong knowledge of production planning, quality systems, health and safety, and continuous improvement methodologies.   Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a high-volume, fast-moving manufacturing setting.   Experience managing KPIs, budgets, cost control, and operational performance.   Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.   Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related discipline preferred.   Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications would be an advantage.

title: Coordenador de Armazém - Page Interim
description:
Empresa está contratando Coordenador de Armazém - Page Interim em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Experiência prévia com gestão de armazém para volumes secos.   Conhecimento avançado em inglês.    Sobre nosso cliente   Empresa nacional do setor de embalagens busca, através de Page Interim, Coordenador de Depósito para liderar a gestão de armazéns de embalagens e caixas metálicas, em que será responsável pela programação de expedições e coletas, gestão de volumes, tratativa de desvios de qualidade e reporte de indicadores de desempenho para a matriz global.   Descrição   Liderar e gerenciar todas as operações do depósito/armazém, garantindo que as metas de produção sejam atingidas de forma regular, segura e eficiente.   Garantir a execução precisa e pontual de todas as transações do sistema (SAP, GEMS, RFID/digitalização), incluindo o fechamento do mês e as atualizações de estoque.   Gerenciar os níveis de estoque para garantir um tempo de resposta rápido, reduzindo o estoque ocioso e mantendo o trabalho em andamento (WIP) dentro das metas definidas (por exemplo, não mais do que 7 dias).   Monitorar, analisar e reduzir danos e rejeições por parte de destinatários e embaladores, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas para resolver as causas-raiz.   Supervisionar os fluxos de entrada e saída para garantir um tráfego fluido, carga/descarga eficiente e uso otimizado da capacidade do depósito.   Gerenciar e melhorar continuamente os processos de controle de qualidade e inspeção para manter os padrões de qualidade e reduzir reclamações de clientes.   Preparar e conduzir CARs eficazes para reclamações de clientes e não conformidades internas, garantindo um acompanhamento robusto e o encerramento dos casos.   Estabelecer, manter e fazer cumprir os SOPs, fluxos de processo e padrões de inspeção no depósito, alinhados com os procedimentos globais.   Exercer uma liderança firme e assertiva junto às equipes dos depósitos e prestadores de serviços, responsabilizando-os pelo desempenho, conformidade e segurança.   Conduzir negociações e avaliações de desempenho com os prestadores de serviços de depósito e logística, garantindo melhores níveis de serviço, eficiência de custos e confiabilidade.   Identificar e resolver questões operacionais complexas, utilizando análise de dados e colaboração multifuncional para implementar soluções sustentáveis e criativas.   Impulsionar o controle, a redução e a contenção de custos nas operações do depósito, aplicando uma visão de custo total de propriedade a todas as despesas.   Oferecer um alto padrão de atendimento ao cliente para as partes interessadas internas e externas, garantindo uma comunicação clara, proativa e orientada para soluções.   Gerenciar a comunicação operacional diária (por exemplo, e-mails, relatórios, painéis) para manter as partes interessadas informadas sobre desempenho, riscos e planos de ação.   Apoiar o Gerente de Cadeia de Suprimentos e a equipe local conforme necessário, atuando como ponto de contato principal para assuntos e iniciativas relacionados ao depósito.    Perfil desejável   Graduação em qualquer área de Engenharia, Logística, Cadeia de Suprimentos, Gestão de Armazéns ou áreas correlatas;   Experiência em gestão de armazéns;   Conhecimentos de informática - Microsoft Office, Outlook, etc;   Conhecimento em SAP;   Conhecimento em ISO 45001 e WMS;   Experiência com Lean / Six Sigma será diferencial;   Conhecimento avançado em inglês.    O que está sendo ofertado   Faixa salarial de R$8.000,00 a R$10.000,00;   Contrato terceiro (CLT) através de Page Interim;   Modelo de Trabalho: modelo híbrido 3x2 (Campinas/SP).   #J-18808-Ljbffr

How familiar are you with coding best practices?  Proficiency in SOLID and clean coding principles, especially in the context of scalable solutions, is a must-have for this role.    What's your experience with code reviews and automated testing?  We're looking for candidates with extensive experience in conducting code reviews, writing automated tests, and implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging a variety of programming languages.    Can you demonstrate expertise in testing?  Strong expertise in both unit testing and integration testing is essential, with a focus on maintaining high code coverage to ensure the reliability of our software solutions.    How do you approach technical decision-making?  We're seeking someone who can make informed technical decisions and tailor approaches to suit each unique use case, driving innovation and efficiency.    What is your level of knowledge in IT infrastructure?  A solid understanding of IT infrastructure is crucial for this role, ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and secure.    Is your English proficiency at an advanced level?  Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams.    Are you located in Argentina?  Candidates must reside in Argentina to be eligible for this position.    What Would Be a Plus?    Do you have experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or CircleCI?  Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our DevOps challenges.    Are you well-versed in system security principles?  A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role.    Are you available to work on call when needed?  Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times.    What We Offer     Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, shaping your ideal work environment.   Competitive Compensation: Choose between compensation options in USD or your local currency, tailored to your financial preferences.   Home Office Equipment: We provide the necessary tech to ensure you have a comfortable and efficient home workspace.   Flexible Work Schedule: Create a work schedule that aligns with your lifestyle, giving you the freedom to balance work and life.   Comprehensive Leave: Take advantage of paid parental leave, vacation time, and observed national holidays.   Cultural Diversity: Immerse yourself in a multicultural workplace that celebrates innovation and creativity.   Elite Teamwork: Collaborate with top industry professionals, learning and growing with the best.   Career Support: Benefit from a nurturing environment focused on mentorship, skill development, and varied growth opportunities.

description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿ em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:  The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region. Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.  Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.   Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.   Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.   Other duties, as assigned.  Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up   POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: DevOps Engineer - Remote
description:

Get ready to architect cutting-edge solutions, mentor budding talents, and infuse innovation into our deployment processes. Armed with your expertise in automation, cloud services, and system administration, you'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our technological landscape. If you're passionate about driving change and leaving a lasting impact, this is the role for you. What Will I Do?  What will my main tasks be? You'll strategically develop and maintain advanced CI/CD pipelines, integrating the latest tools and techniques to streamline our deployment processes. How will I contribute to the team? Your role is pivotal in architecting and managing robust, scalable cloud infrastructure solutions, harnessing the power of cutting-edge cloud services to propel us forward. Will I collaborate with other departments? Absolutely! You'll work closely with product owners and client services to ensure our solutions resonate with our clients and meet their evolving needs. Are You the Right Fit?  Do you have extensive experience with DevOps? We're seeking candidates with over 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevOps realm, ready to take on the next challenge. How familiar are you with coding best practices? Proficiency in SOLID and clean coding principles, especially in the context of scalable solutions, is a must-have for this role. What's your experience with code reviews and automated testing? We're looking for candidates with extensive experience in conducting code reviews, writing automated tests, and implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging a variety of programming languages. Can you demonstrate expertise in testing? Strong expertise in both unit testing and integration testing is essential, with a focus on maintaining high code coverage to ensure the reliability of our software solutions. How do you approach technical decision-making? We're seeking someone who can make informed technical decisions and tailor approaches to suit each unique use case, driving innovation and efficiency. What is your level of knowledge in IT infrastructure? A solid understanding of IT infrastructure is crucial for this role, ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and secure. Is your English proficiency at an advanced level? Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams. Are you located in Argentina? Candidates must reside in Argentina to be eligible for this position. What Would Be a Plus?  Do you have experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or CircleCI? Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our DevOps challenges. Are you well-versed in system security principles? A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role. Are you available to work on call when needed? Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times. What We Offer  Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, shaping your ideal work environment. Competitive Compensation: Choose between compensation options in USD or your local currency, tailored to your financial preferences. Home Office Equipment: We provide the necessary tech to ensure you have a comfortable and efficient home workspace. Flexible Work Schedule: Create a work schedule that aligns with your lifestyle, giving you the freedom to balance work and life. Comprehensive Leave: Take advantage of paid parental leave, vacation time, and observed national holidays. Cultural Diversity: Immerse yourself in a multicultural workplace that celebrates innovation and creativity. Elite Teamwork: Collaborate with top industry professionals, learning and growing with the best. Career Support: Benefit from a nurturing environment focused on mentorship, skill development, and varied growth opportunities.

Manter-se atualizado por meio da participação em cursos, seminários e outras atividades de desenvolvimento profissional, visando melhoria contínua e acompanhamento das inovações tecnológicas. title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.   This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.   What you'll do   Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for   We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.   You'll be successful in this role if you have:   Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required)   Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us   You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.   Equal Opportunity   Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?   Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.   Necessário:   Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial?   Aqui você é mais que um professor.   Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.   Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.   Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.   Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.   Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!   O que eu faço? QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?   Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.   Seja diferente, seja independente

We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.   About the Role   The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.   Responsibilities   Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications   5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills   ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like   Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. Ideal Candidate   The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando.   Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui.   E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA  O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro.   A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca.   Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual.   Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:  Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:Esperamos uma pessoa com olhar apurado, autonomia criativa e vontade real de construir.   Alguém que consiga pegar um tema complexo e transformar em uma animação clara. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first.   Na Pay Conductor, você terá espaço para propor, testar e evoluir a linguagem visual de uma marca que está entrando em uma categoria nova e estratégica para o mercado brasileiro. title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.   EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.   Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.   Tasks and responsibilities:   Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile:   Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;   Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);   Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;   Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Captain - airbus a320
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Captain - airbus a320 em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description  Make the world your home.    It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.    Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.    What we offer    Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role  As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.   Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring  To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:   A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.
